_comment: Decisions on pay leads (scripts/find_pay_leads.py, docs/PAY_LEADS.md): a post the matching rules have not tied to a printed row,
whose title the current Plum Book export prints under the post's own agency (in an organisation no node was matched to or one in the
post's own chain), or, for an agency this graph has no node for, in an organisation named for the post's own parent.
A row closes the lead and keeps the reason beside it; it never publishes a figure. A row counts only while its `name` is the post's
current name (a rename makes it stale and the lead stays open), its kind is one of the three below and its basis is non-empty;
an unreadable file is an error, never an empty one.
kind: not_this_post (the export's office is a different office from this node) and stamp_not_a_post_of_this_agency (the node is a
copied template title the agency does not carry) CLOSE the lead. needs_a_reviewed_row (the owner says it IS the post) does NOT:
the lead stays open, marked awaiting a row, until a reviewed row exists, because this file supplies no figure.
Each row: nodeId, name, kind, basis, decidedOn.
